equipmotion.config.title: Equip Motion
equipmotion.config.enabled.tooltip: Add a shaped draw and holster movement when changing held items.
equipmotion.config.style.tooltip: Choose the path used as an item is lowered and drawn. Timing follows Minecraft's item swap.
equipmotion.config.amount.tooltip: Scale the extra movement and rotation. Zero keeps the original swap motion.
equipmotion.config.preserveUseAnimations: Keep the original pose while eating, drinking, blocking, or charging an item.
equipmotion.config.mainHand.tooltip: Animate item changes in the main hand, including left-handed players.
equipmotion.config.offHand.tooltip: Animate item changes in the off hand with a mirrored path.
equipmotion.config.emptyHand.tooltip: Apply the motion to the bare hand when switching away from an item.
equipmotion.config.sponsor: Sponsored by CTF Launcher — try it out
equipmotion.config.saveError: Could not save Equip Motion settings
equipmotion.config.saveError.detail: Check write access to the config folder.
equipmotion.config.weightedMotion.toolti: Shields and heavy tools follow wider paths; food, bottles and torches move more lightly.
equipmotion.config.responseTicks.tooltip: Smooth changing trajectories and interrupted swaps. Higher values follow the target more gently. Zero follows the native equip progress immediately.
